title: Finite Long-Code Test Boundary
statement: Let $q$ be a natural number, let $\Psi$ be a set of sign predicates, and let a sign tester with alphabet size $q$ be given. A long-code test boundary consists of the assumptions that $\Psi$ is finite and that every check selected by the tester uses a predicate in $\Psi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\Psi$ is a set of sign predicates
every tester check uses a predicate in $\Psi$
